narr: Scattered to numerous thunderstorms developed ahead of a slow moving cold front. The training of thunderstorms over Madison led to the flash flooding of streets. Another thunderstorm produced tree damage in southwest Dodge County.
ev: Numerous reports of street flooding in the Madison area. A couple of streets closed due to high water with estimated depths of 8-10 inches.
lsr: Numerous reports of street flooding around Madison during persistent heavy rain. A couple of streets closed due to high water. Estimated water was 8 to 10 inches deep in intersections.
